self-menu.description: Run custom shell commands from a configurable right-click submenu
self-menu.submenu.label: Self Menu
self-menu.config.title: Self Menu
self-menu.items.description: Menu items shown in the right-click submenu. Each item opens a terminal and runs the configured shell command.
self-menu.items.label.description: Display name of the menu item
self-menu.items.description.description: Optional short description shown in the picker
self-menu.items.cwd.description: Optional working directory for the terminal. Supports variables: ${workspaceFolder} ${file} ${path} ${dir} ${name} ${extname} ${basename}
